summary: Completed focused testing of 4 reported bug fixes plus header/nav changes. All bugs are FIXED and working correctly. BUG 1: Diagnosis comments are green, translated, and excluded from abnormal count (0 findings shown for clean cars). BUG 2: Photos in ascending order by code (1, 2, 3...). BUG 3: Make and Model dropdowns alphabetically sorted by label. BUG 4: Trim level dropdown correctly hidden (only 3 dropdowns: Make, Model, Submodel). Header layout correct (hamburger left, logo center, theme right, no favourites button). Navigation drawer contains all required elements. Regression checks passed (10 cards/page, 16:9 images from ci.encar.com).

minor_notes.impact: On first load of a car with uncached diagnosis comments, one or more comments may briefly display Korean text before translation completes. After page reload or subsequent visits, translations are served from cache instantly.
minor_notes.note: This is expected behavior matching the dealer description translation pattern. Translations are cached forever after first request.
